User is planning a November Europe trip and seeks central Paris hotels with Eiffel Tower views (S2.U1-U2). Budget is $200–300/night; wants a fitness center and breakfast included (S2.U2). They are considering Hilton Paris Eiffel Tower, Pullman Paris Tour Eiffel, and Novotel Paris Tour Eiffel, and requested comparisons of rates, amenities, and breakfast quality/variety/atmosphere (S2.U3-U6). They asked how close Hilton Paris Eiffel Tower is to the tower and whether Pullman’s breakfast has hot items versus continental-style food (S2.U3,U5). Assistant suggested Hilton is a short walk, compared November rates, and described both breakfasts; these details are assistant suggestions/claims and should be independently verified (S2.U3-U6).

User has enough Hilton Honors points for two free nights, which supersedes the prior one-free-night plan, and may use them for a separate Las Vegas trip (S2.U2). For that trip, they were considering Hilton Lake Las Vegas Resort, Hilton Grand Vacations Club on the Las Vegas Strip, and Waldorf Astoria Las Vegas; especially interested in Waldorf Astoria room/suite types, sizes, layouts, views, and amenities (S1.U3-U6).
